title: Chains of custody
purpose: Find the laboratory order representing one chain of custody and the samples received against it. Orders can exist before physical receipt.
summary: Every chain of custody the laboratory has opened, with its client, project, turnaround, delivery target and the samples received on it.

tasks.title: Find a chain of custody
steps: Type a reference, purchase order, tracking number, project or client in [[Search]].
Select [[Apply]], then select the reference to open it.

tasks.title: Start receiving a shipment
steps: Select [[New chain of custody]], fill in the paperwork details and create it.
Receive each physical sample from the new chain of custody.

good_to_know: A chain of custody can exist before any sample arrives. Samples counts only samples actually received.
The delivery target is the date agreed with the client. It is separate from analytical holding times.
Cancelled chains of custody stay in the list and in searches, marked beside the reference.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches chain-of-custody reference, purchase order, carrier / tracking number, project name or client name.

items.label: Client
items.description: Exact owning client, including inactive clients for history.

items.label: Turnaround
items.description: Any turnaround, Standard or Rush.

items.label: Project
items.description: More filters: exact project. When Client is selected, Project must belong to it.

items.label: Created from / Created to
items.description: More filters: inclusive creation dates in laboratory local time; end cannot precede start.

items.label: New chain of custody
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators create an order before receiving its samples.

items.label: Chain of custody row link
items.description: Opens the order, including any cancelled record; cancellation is marked alongside the reference.

items.label: Chain of custody
items.description: Entered reference for the order.

items.label: Client / Project
items.description: Project and its owning client.

items.label: Samples
items.description: Number of received samples, not planned submission samples.

items.label: Turnaround
items.description: Rush (marked) or Standard. Sortable.

items.label: Delivery target
items.description: Explicit client commitment or Not set; separate from analytical holding times.

items.label: Purchase order
items.description: Initially hidden. The order’s purchase order, or a dash. Sortable.

items.label: Delivery
items.description: Initially hidden. Delivery method followed by any carrier / tracking number, or a dash. Not sortable.

items.label: Created
items.description: Order creation time; default sort is newest creation first.

items.label: Created by
items.description: Initially hidden staff member who created the order.

sections.title: Table controls
paragraphs: Staff with a laboratory role can read the list; client portal users cannot. Invalid criteria show errors and no rows, rather than silently widening the search. Invalid page sizes are refused. Clear filters or correct errors to continue.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Search is case-insensitive contained text; Apply combines search and filters over the full dataset and returns to page 1.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens advanced criteria and remains open when they are active or invalid.

items.label: Clear all / filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Removing a chip clears just that criterion and starts at page 1.

items.label: Column headings and Columns
items.description: Linked headings sort the complete matching set, with record ID breaking ties. Columns controls optional visibility and order, saved for your account; reset restores default presentation. Identifying columns stay visible.

items.label: Rows per page / Show
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows, default 25. Size changes return to page 1. Show is the fallback when automatic submission is unavailable.

items.label: Pagination
items.description: First, Previous, Next and Last retain search, filters and sort; counts describe matching records.

sections.title: Empty states
paragraphs: No chains of custody yet offers New chain of custody when your role permits. A no-match state suggests checking the reference, widening dates or clearing filters. Cancelled and inactive-client history remains searchable; the list has no cancellation-status filter.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility for your account.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
